1.1.1: Added output examples to component schemas.
2.0.0: (breaking change) MakeApiCall: headers and parameters changed to key-value array inputs per standard #1459 — existing flows that previously set these as JSON strings must migrate to the key-value editor. Body remains textarea/JSON.
2.0.1: Component icons are now the official LINE SVG mark instead of PNG bitmaps.
ListRichMenus: the output-port schema call no longer performs a live, authenticated LINE API request just to build the variable picker.
2.0.2: Fixed a crash when a Find/List component saved an EMPTY result set to a CSV file — the header row was built from the first record without checking there was one, so a search that legitimately matched nothing failed the flow instead of writing an empty file.
2.0.3: MakeApiCall: Request Headers and Query Parameters set in the Designer are now sent. They were silently dropped: the key-value field stores its rows as a JSON object string, which the component did not parse.
